constructor.notice: The contract pools all saved USDC at this contract address. Circle (USDC issuer) retains the ability to freeze any address at the protocol level. While extremely unlikely for a compliant savings contract, a freeze would prevent withdrawals. Users should be aware of this centralized-stablecoin custody risk inherent to any USDC-holding contract.

 Circle (USDC issuer) retains the ability to freeze any address at the
 protocol level. While extremely unlikely for a compliant savings contract,
 a freeze would prevent withdrawals. Users should be aware of this
 centralized-stablecoin custody risk inherent to any USDC-holding contract.
